description: The smart-list evaluator (sync-wave read contract section 3): which held entity.card records a Composer set shows and in what order. Each case installs `records` with complete entity.card and collection.member coverage (workspace.shell coverage as `shell_entity_types`) and evaluates `list` for `account` with `params`, `page` and `page_size`. A case's own `records`, when present, replace the shared ones. `groups` (when present) is the Groups v1 metadata for the page's records: descriptors as [key, label] in rank order (rank = priority, then the label's UTF-8 bytes, then the key's), and each entity's group key. Name collation is ICU root with default (non-numeric) options; expected collation orders were produced by the ICU root collator in Bun (JavaScriptCore) and Node (V8), which agree, and cases are limited to characters whose root order is stable across recent CLDR versions (common Latin with accents, basic kana, common jōyō kanji, ASCII digits, full-width ASCII, one common emoji). Status group descriptors carry keys only ([key]): their labels are the reader's words, resolved at render from priv/display_copy.json (values.<status>, ui.groups.noStatus), en and ja; type groups carry the type's own name. A collection's source order is its manual order: members with an order_key first, keys compared code unit by code unit (the server's COLLATE "C"; never the ICU collator), then members without a key by added_at, ties by entity_id; courses and albums order by position first as before. order_key is fractional-indexing base-62 ASCII ([0-9A-Za-z], 2 to 128 characters), so code-unit and byte order agree; the server's write boundary (Relay.Collections.OrderKey.valid?/1) refuses any other key, so no case carries one. A collection is partial only when its id is in the population manifest's collection.member server_projected list (the top-level case input `server_projected`, next to `shell_entity_types`; absent means an empty list) or its card is not held; otherwise it is evaluated locally, shared and other-workspace collections included. Query-listed members (source "query") order by position, then entity_id.

cases.name: collection default: added order, finished tasks hidden
collection dir asc reverses the source order
name asc: downcased name, ties by entity_id
name desc reverses the whole list
newest by insertion at microsecond precision
oldest by insertion at microsecond precision
completed show includes finished tasks
content_source mine
content_source others includes an unknown creator
tag_names normalized, one tag
tag_names all-of
text is a case-insensitive name substring
type_slugs with a complete shell catalog
type_slugs ignored while the shell catalog is partial
type_slugs naming no enabled type filter nothing
a page past the end clamps to the last page
course: members without a position first, then lessons by position
album: assets by position first, then the rest by added order
inbox: rank key, then name, then id
inbox newest by arrival
pinned: newest pin first, then pin id descending
recent: newest open first
shared: entity id order
trash: newest deletion first at microsecond precision
inbox name collation: accents (secondary: acute before grave)
inbox name collation: case (lowercase first at the tertiary level)
inbox name collation: digits are not numeric (item 10 before item 2)
inbox name collation: hiragana before katakana, kana before kanji
inbox name collation: half-width before full-width, lowercase first
inbox name collation: an emoji sorts before digits and letters
inbox name collation: mixed Latin and Japanese
a page size below 1 clamps to 1
type groups: the shell type name labels each group, ranked by label
status groups: every status the page's types accept, in status order
status groups for types without statuses: one No Status group
type groups across three types
manual order: order_key code unit by code unit (Zz before a0), keyed members before the rest, then added order, ties by entity id
manual order reversed by dir asc
query-listed collection: its members in position order, ties by entity id
another workspace's shared collection is evaluated locally
a server_projected collection is partial: its pages come from the server
a collection whose card is not held is partial
